result.description:
Your new company  
 Our client is a respected structural steel fabrication and installation specialist servicing commercial, industrial, and residential projects across Victoria. Due to continued growth, they are seeking experienced Machine Operators to join their workshop team on afternoon shift. 
 With a strong focus on quality, efficiency, and long-term client relationships, they offer stable employment and career progression for operators who take pride in precision and workmanship. 
   Your new role  
   
 You will be responsible for operating and maintaining plasma cutting machines and brake press (bending) equipment within a busy fabrication workshop. Reporting to the Workshop Supervisor, you'll work alongside boilermakers, welders, and trade assistants to ensure production targets and quality standards are met. 
 
 
 Operating CNC plasma cutting machines to cut structural steel components 
 
 
 Operating brake press machines to bend and form steel accurately 
 
 
 Performing machine setup, adjustments, and basic programming (where required) 
 
 
 Ensuring all components meet precise measurements and tolerances 
 
 
 Conducting routine maintenance and safety checks on machinery 
 
 
 Working collaboratively with the workshop team to meet deadlines 
 
 
  What you'll need to succeed  
 
 
 Proven experience operating plasma cutting and/or brake press machines 
 
 
 Ability to read and interpret technical/engineering drawings 
 
 
 Strong attention to detail and accuracy 
 
 
 Experience working in a structural steel or fabrication environment 
 
 
 Good understanding of workplace safety practices 
 
 
 Reliable, punctual, and able to work both independently and in a team 
 
 
 Forklift ticket is a must 
 
 
  What you'll get in return  
 
 
 Competitive hourly rate based on experience 
 
 
 Overtime opportunities available 
 
 
 Stable, long-term employment with a growing company 
 
 
 Supportive workshop environment with modern machinery 
 
 
 Opportunities to upskill and progress within the business 
 
 
  What you need to do now  
 If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV to marco.dirmeier@hays.com.au  Please  click here  to apply.

result.description:
Location: 		Port Broughton, SA, 5522
Full-Time: 		Immediate start
Reports to:		Aged Care Facility Manager
Job Title: 		Enrolled Nurse
Salary range: 	$79,500 - $85,000 - depending on skills level and work experience + superannuation.
Job Closure date: 30 days

About This Role
Our client is a highly respected aged care provider in the Port Broughton region, known for person-centred care and modern, homelike facilities. We are seeking a full-time Enrolled Nurse to join their dedicated team. This role offers long-term stability in a well-resourced facility that values staff. You will provide hands-on clinical and personal care, foster meaningful resident connections, and work within a collaborative team. The position includes ongoing training and professional development to support your growth in the aged care sector.

Key Responsibilities
• Assist in assessing, planning, and implementing resident care under RN supervision.
• Administer medications and treatments per facility protocols.
• Monitor and document health status, reporting changes to the RN.
• Perform wound care, catheter management, and other clinical interventions.
• Support residents with ADLs (bathing, dressing, mobility, feeding).
• Uphold person-centred care respecting dignity and preferences.
• Engage residents in social activities to enhance wellbeing.
• Provide emotional support to residents and families.
• Adhere to infection control, WHS, and aged care quality standards.
• Maintain accurate documentation in care records.
• Follow facility policies and regulatory requirements.
• Work effectively within a multidisciplinary team.
• Participate in handovers, meetings, and training.
• Mentor less experienced care staff as needed.

Qualifications & Requirements
Essential:
• Diploma of Nursing with current AHPRA registration as an EN.
• Minimum 1 year aged care/dementia care experience (preferred).
• Strong clinical skills in medication administration and chronic disease management.
• Knowledge of Aged Care Quality Standards and person-centred care.
• Current First Aid & CPR certification.
• National Police Check and NDIS Worker Screening.
• Annual flu vaccination and full COVID-19 immunisation compliance.

Desirable:
• Palliative care and complex health needs experience.
• Knowledge of electronic health records (e.g., iCare, MHR).
• Thrives in a team environment and seeks long-term employment.
Personal Attributes:
• Compassionate, patient, and empathetic.
• Strong communication and teamwork skills.
• Resilient and able to work in a fast-paced environment.

Benefits
• Competitive hourly rates + penalty rates (if applicable).
• Ongoing training and career development opportunities.
• Supportive and collaborative team environment.

Job description
Position: Marketing Coordinator
Type: Full-time
Salary: AUD 80,000/year
Employer: HONEST TO GOODNESS PTY LTD (HONEST TO GOODNESS)
Location: 100 McEvoy Street, Alexandria, NSW, 2015

About us:
AUSTRALIAN CERTIFIED ORGANIC We're a trusted retailer, wholesaler and distributor of wholesome, sustainable, organic food and natural products. We source and deliver products you can feel good about. Shop 1000+ products online or visit our retail store in Alexandria, Sydney.

Position Available:
Australian Certified Organic is seeking a dedicated Full-Time Marketing Coordinator to join our team. Reporting to the Marketing Manager, you will develop and execute marketing campaigns, manage digital and social media channels, and promote our range of sustainable organic products to both retail and wholesale customers. You will also coordinate promotional activities, create engaging content, and support in-store and online sales initiatives. Candidates with prior experience in retail, FMCG, or e-commerce marketing will be highly regarded. This is a great opportunity to grow your career while being part of a team committed to quality, sustainability, and wholesome natural foods.

Responsibilities:
1. Conduct market research within Australia’s organic healthy food industry to discover growth opportunities for existing and new brand products.
2. Collect and analyze consumer and competitor data to evaluate local market demand for sustainable, clean-label grocery items.
3. Develop and implement brand-aligned marketing plans and targets to drive retail and wholesale business growth.
4. Provide professional guidance on product portfolio adjustments based on feedback from Australian wellness consumers.
5. Advise on pricing, online advertising and seasonal promotions suitable for the brand’s premium organic positioning.
6. Optimize marketing cooperation for e-commerce platforms and offline retail distribution channels.
7. Design promotion strategies to boost brand exposure among eco-friendly and health-focused local audiences.
8. Maintain a consistent brand identity centred on ethical sourcing and sustainability across all marketing activities.
9. Support key account management by responding to B2B customer inquiries regarding product availability, pricing, and new product range.
10. Manage and update customer portals (e.g., Amazon, Metcash, Ordermentum) with accurate product data, pricing, and digital assets to support wholesale operations.

Requirements:
Relevant bachelor’s degree qualification plus one year of relevant working experience.

What we offer:
1. Competitive Salary: $80,000 per year package.
2. Career Development: Ongoing training and opportunities for growth within the business.
3. Supportive Team: Be part of a friendly and collaborative work environment.

MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Casual Community Support Worker WHD4-WHD3 - Streaky Bay



 Apply now
 Job no: 944257

 Work type: Casual

 Location: Eyre and Western

 Categories: Catering and Hospitality, Community and Social Services, Child, Aged and Disability Care, Support Services





 

Eyre and Far North Local Health Network, Country Health Connect - Home Support 

Position based in Streaky Bay

Salary:

WHD3: $32.90 - $33.72 per hour + 25% casual loading

WHD4: $34.58 - $35.27 per hour + 25% casual loading

Casual positions available until 30 June 2027, working over a 7 day roster

Please note that this position is multi-classified as either a WHD-3 or WHD-4.

Exciting Casual Opportunity: Community Support Worker 

In the coastal community of Streaky Bay, the work of a Community Support Worker carries real weight. At Eyre and Far North Local Health Network (EFNLHN), you'll be the person who helps someone stay in the home they love - offering practical support, genuine connection, and the kind of care that makes independence possible.

What You'll Be Doing

Working within EFNLHN's Consumer Directed Care model, you'll deliver support shaped by each client's own goals and preferences - because here, the consumer leads the care. Shifts, duties, and frequency are guided by the people you support, giving your work real purpose and variety.

Assist clients with personal hygiene, grooming, and mobility in a respectful and dignified manner

Perform household tasks including cleaning, laundry, meal preparation, and minor gardening

Provide reliable transport to appointments and community outings

Support social engagement and activities that contribute to client wellbeing

At the WHA4 level, deliver personal care to clients with more complex support needs

What You'll Bring

A warm, empathetic approach and the confidence to work independently in the community

Sound communication skills and genuine respect for people from diverse cultures and backgrounds

Experience supporting aged, frail, or disabled individuals

Ability to work collaboratively as part of a small, community-based team

Familiarity with SA Health's person-centred care frameworks is highly regarded

For appointment at WHA4 level: Certificate III or higher in Individual Support (Aged Care, Disability, or Home and Community)

Life at Streaky Bay and EFNLHN

EFNLHN serves one of Australia's most geographically distinctive regions, and Streaky Bay sits within one of its most tightly knit communities. As a SA Health employee, you'll access salary packaging benefits that meaningfully increase your take-home pay, alongside the professional backing of a broader health network. This casual role offers genuine flexibility, and the Consumer Directed Care model means your day-to-day work reflects the real preferences of the people you serve - not a one-size-fits-all schedule. Your contribution here is visible, valued, and felt directly by the community around you. This position is available through to 30 June 2027.

Ready to Apply

Submit your application through the SA Health careers portal with a current resume and a cover letter outlining your experience in community or personal care. For a conversation about the role, contact the EFNLHN Streaky Bay Community and Allied Health team directly. We welcome applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples and those with lived experience in community care.

About Us

With its ancient outback landscapes, boutique vineyards, oyster farms and Australia's best-kept-secret surf coast, Eyre and Far North will inspire and energise you.

The Eyre and Far North Local Health Network (EFNLHN) is responsible for the planning and delivery of hospital and health services over 337,626 square kilometres, taking in the Eyre Peninsula, western part of South Australia and north to Coober Pedy. We are one of the largest LHNs by area in Australia and communities include Ceduna, Cleve, Coober Pedy, Cowell, Cummins, Elliston, Kimba, Oodnadatta, Port Lincoln, Streaky Bay, Tumby Bay and Wudinna.

Services include acute care, medical, accident and emergency, surgery, birthing and midwifery, specialist consultancy, renal dialysis, chemotherapy, transfusions, rehabilitation, residential and community aged care, respite care, transitional care packages, Aboriginal health, mental health, allied health, community health, community nursing, palliative care, community home support packages and home modifications.

Click here to learn more about living and working in Eyre and Far North Local Health Network.

Why Join Us

Make a real difference and feel like an important part of the community. Being part of Eyre & Far North means you will be supported both personally and professionally, can take advantage of education and training opportunities, will have access to flexible working hours and be part of an inter-professional approach to holistic health care.

Salary package a range of benefits (including living expenses such as mortgage, rent, utility bills and groceries) up to $9,010 each FBT year + $2,650 for Meal Entertainment expenses each FBT year Click here more information

Wellbeing and counselling support: support for you and your family via our free Employee Assistance Program

Relocation support: relocation reimbursement of up to $15,000 may be available to people relocating for this opportunity. More information available from SA Health Careers - Relocation support.

Employee recognition: supportive and collaborative work environment where your contributions are valued and recognised.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

SA Health is committed to providing an inclusive workplace that embraces diversity and inclusion for all employees. We strongly encourage applications from people of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander descent, culturally diverse backgrounds, members of the LGBTIQA+SB community and people who live with disability and-or neurodivergence.

We are committed to making workplace adjustments to provide a positive and supportive work environment. You are encouraged to let us know if have any support or access requirements during the recruitment process and beyond to ensure you can perform at your best.

Applicant Information

The South Australian public sector promotes diversity and flexible ways of working part-time. Applicants are encouraged to discuss the flexible working arrangements for this role.

Appointment will be subject to a satisfactory Criminal History Check and appropriate immunisation requirements.

Check(s)

DHS National Disability Insurance Scheme (NDIS) Worker Check

National Police Certificate (NPC) for employment involving unsupervised contact with vulnerable groups required for this position (E.g. aged care employment or work involving vulnerable clients)

Immunisation Risk for this position is - Category A (direct contact with blood or body substances)

SA Health Services are required to implement the Addressing vaccine preventable disease: Occupational asse
